name: SJ Foundation AI base LM v0.1
architecture: decoder-only Transformer, 7 layers, 5 heads, d_model 320, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, tied embeddings
data_license: Original text written for this project, CC0-1.0
limitations: A small experimental base language model trained from random initialization on a very small original corpus (about 5,000 tokens). It continues text in Marathi, Hindi and English and can complete short, simple sentences. It is not instruction-tuned, has no general knowledge, and will produce incorrect or repetitive text. It is not comparable to large commercial assistants.
